title: Synthesis innovations for crystallizing covalent organic framework thin films on biological and non-biological substrates
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01222D, Review Article
Ashok Kumar Mahato, Satyadip Paul, Rahul Banerjee
This review highlights the significance of growing covalent organic framework (COF) thin films on suitable substrates (biological and non-biological) tailored for various applications.
